title: A magical sunset experience in Seville!
text: The rooftop views were breathtaking, and enjoying the drinks while watching the city change colors was truly unforgettable. The relaxed atmosphere made it the perfect place to slow down, unwind, and enjoy a special moment.
author: paucxmbil

title: Sunset lindo
text: It was very nice, we were in a couple but we would calmly go with friends too because it is really a very relaxed Mood, the gentleman who served us was also very friendly! Just two things to point out: 1 I think 1h30 was little time and 2 that as the terrace was being renovated there were some loose floors only ara pay attention to this! We recommend 100%
